preview.exposure: Exactly 8 existing engineering recipe outputs and their linked documented ingredient sources (including 5 smelts and 6 mining-vein claims); research-only, not confirmed in-game, no seller claim promoted.

note.fr: Prévisualisation documentaire facultative : 8 recettes d’ingénierie, 5 fontes documentées pour Forever et 6 liens minerais/pierres vers des filons décrits dans le guide Forever. Rendements contradictoires conservés inconnus ; vendeurs issus de Classic non confirmés sur Forever. Aucune acquisition n'est confirmée en jeu.
note.en: Optional documentary preview: 8 engineering recipes, 5 Forever-documented smelting routes, 6 guide-sourced ore/stone vein claims. Conflicting yields remain unknown, Classic seller leads unconfirmed; no acquisition independently confirmed in game.
